user_can_favorite_item.evidence: favorite_item adds owned item IDs to User.favorite_item_ids and returns the item dict.

user_can_unfavorite_item.evidence: unfavorite_item removes owned item IDs from User.favorite_item_ids when present and returns the item dict.

user_can_list_favorite_items.evidence: list_favorite_items returns item dictionaries for the user's favorite_item_ids.

favoriting_non_owned_item_fails.evidence: _get_owned_item raises ValueError when the user does not own the item.

favoriting_same_item_twice_is_idempotent.evidence: User.favorite_item appends only when the item is not already favorited.

unfavoriting_non_favorited_item_is_idemp.evidence: User.unfavorite_item removes only when the item is currently favorited.
